import polars as pl

def dataframes_equal(df1: pl.DataFrame, df2: pl.DataFrame) -> bool:
    """
    Check if two polars DataFrames are exactly equal (same schema and values).
    
    Args:
        df1: First DataFrame
        df2: Second DataFrame
    
    Returns:
        True if the DataFrames have the same schema and values, False otherwise
    """
    return df1.equals(df2)


# Example usage
if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Test case 1: Identical DataFrames
    df1 = pl.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2, 3], "b": [4, 5, 6]})
    df2 = pl.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2, 3], "b": [4, 5, 6]})
    print(dataframes_equal(df1, df2))  # True
    
    # Test case 2: Different values
    df3 = pl.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2, 3], "b": [4, 5, 7]})
    print(dataframes_equal(df1, df3))  # False
    
    # Test case 3: Different schema
    df4 = pl.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2, 3], "c": [4, 5, 6]})
    print(dataframes_equal(df1, df4))  # False
    
    # Test case 4: Different column order
    df5 = pl.DataFrame({"b": [4, 5, 6], "a": [1, 2, 3]})
    print(dataframes_equal(df1, df5))  # False
